title: Single-tenant bearer auth for the factory worker
description: Secrets-not-accounts (D16): no user table, no signup. A deploy-time factory token is minted client-side; its hash (salted, WebCrypto — PBKDF2 or better, explicitly not the bare SHA-256 pattern from cloud/worker/src/auth.ts) is stored as a Worker secret. Middleware on every factory route verifies the bearer token with constant-time comparison; webhook routes are exempted now and use per-source shared secrets later (Phase 3). Include a token rotation path: minting a new token replaces the secret without redeploying the bundle.

acceptance_criteria: All non-health routes reject requests without the token and accept requests with it. The stored value is a salted derived hash, verified by a test, and never appears in logs or config files in the repo. Rotation invalidates the old token in a test against the vitest-pool-workers harness.
closed_reason: Completed: single-tenant bearer auth for the factory worker — PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA-256 record (pbkdf2-sha256$iters$salt$key, 210k iterations, bounds-checked), constant-time verify with a no-early-exit proof, middleware ahead of routing so 401/404 are indistinguishable, /api/hooks/** exempt for Phase 3, fail-closed 503 when unconfigured, and rotation via wrangler secret put with a per-request secret read; 38 new tests, all five mutation checks red as intended.
